title: Unveiling High NA EUV | ASML
summary: ASML's short promotional fly-through of its High NA EUV lithography platform, the TWINSCAN EXE, which supports 8-nanometer resolution. It shows the machine's internals including advanced anamorphic optics.
why: HN links it to show the sheer complexity of EUV machines, especially when discussing whether competitors can challenge ASML.

quote.text: I recommend highly to everyone who thinks a startup can challenge ASML this 1.38min video
